description: This Swift source file defines the CameraController actor which manages camera and microphone access, device enumeration, photo and video capture, and related processing functionalities for an iOS app. It includes methods for snapping photos, clipping videos, listing available camera devices, and utility functions for camera access and video processing.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling photo capture results via AVCapturePhotoCaptureDelegate.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling movie file recording results via AVCaptureFileOutputRecordingDelegate.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo asynchronously with specified parameters, returning image data in base64 along with format, width, and height.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip asynchronously with specified parameters, returning the clip in base64 format along with duration and audio info.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera video input devices with their IDs, names, positions, and device types.
